about: p1 Window Light room (round 4), three.js coordinates (Y up, the camera looks toward -X, screen right = -Z). Read by bake_room.py (Blender: x, -z, y) and by js/room.js. Planes: origin + u + v, normal = u x v into the room. A closed plaster back wall, a plaster left wall meeting it in a corner, a limestone floor with a brass ring track. The one window is in the left wall near the camera, out of frame: the room sees it only as its light (the baked sky fill through it, and the live sun through the screen in it).
